text.p: These are the leading stories in two Algerian newspapers on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Foreign Minister Attaf visits Denmark; Danish government says it will reopen embassy in Algiers soon.
- Thirty people murdered in Chebli south of Algiers early on Thursday.
- Parliamentary election: Algeria has smashed wall of fear and believes only in democracy to end crisis.
- Campaign for June 5 poll unfolding peacefully, confirming Algeria could adapt to multi-party democracy successfully.
(Other Algerian dailies did not appear on Saturday because of the Moslem Achoura feast.)
